title: Plan: source-resident plus batched/fused Q8_0 after combined correctness proof
source_head_before_experiment: current docs-plan head after this artifact is committed

combined_correctness_runtime.interpretation: Correctness is solved for CPU-compatible Q8_0 arithmetic, but the current per-call implementation is too slow to benchmark as SOTA.

hotset_diagnostic.decision: The existing top768 manifest is a starting point only; a promotable design needs a weighted hard-bound using measured fallback time, not record-count coverage alone.

next_analysis_steps_before_code: Build a combined-hotset bound from the 69600-record q80 skip report and the existing CPU fallback timing traces.
For topN candidates, record payload bytes, expected VRAM pressure, hit coverage, estimated removable fallback time, and required kernel/batching overhead.

Reject any topN/source-resident design whose zero-overhead bound cannot exceed the current 4.4 tok/s SOTA and whose 10 tok/s bound cannot save at least 17386.57 ms with less than 1642.887 ms overhead.

Only if the hard-bound is positive, implement a default-off resident source pool keyed by tensor+expert and a batched/fused Q8_0 kernel path that removes full host src0 copy, H2D, per-call cudaMalloc/free, and per-call device sync.

implementation_constraints_if_bound_posi.required_env_gate: new explicit envs; no effect unless enabled
implementation_constraints_if_bound_posi.correctness_gate: fixed-text llama-results top1 must pass before any performance benchmark
implementation_constraints_if_bound_posi.promotion_gate: eval_tok_s > 4.4, TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms, RAM including page cache <=16GB, no swap, coherent France output, committed and pushed source/artifacts, then clean pushed-source reproduction

rollback_rule: If the hard-bound is negative, do not write runtime code for this candidate. If runtime code later fails correctness or performance gates, keep it default-off or revert runtime source and retain only rejected documentation.
